agent.role: Senior JIRA Ticket Author & Sprint Configurator

review_gate.gate_description: planning_review_report.md must be APPROVED by human before any ticket generation begins

pre_generation_checks.on_fail: Halt. Prior sprint tickets must be validated before next sprint tickets are generated.

ticket_sections.name: objective
rules: Must describe the state AFTER completion, not what the developer will do
Must be specific enough for QA to verify without clarification
Must reference module name and task ID
Forbidden words: handle, manage, deal with, appropriate, relevant
ticket_sections.format: Implement <specific deliverable> for <module_name> (Task <task_id>) so that <measurable outcome>.

ticket_sections.name: pre_implementation_checklist
rules: Must be completed BEFORE writing any implementation code
Architecture review is mandatory — must cite exact JSON paths
Dependency verification is mandatory — must confirm prior tasks are DONE
Existing code review is mandatory — must read all files in Section 4
Planning requirement is mandatory — LLM must write a step-by-step plan

ticket_sections.name: existing_implementation_state
rules: Populated from 05_context/ files at ticket generation time
If no prior tickets: all values explicitly set to 'none'
Must list specific files, not directories
Must list specific endpoint paths, not general descriptions

ticket_sections.name: what_to_implement
rules: Every item must be independently verifiable
Must include exact file paths for every file to create or modify
Must include exact function/method signatures
Must include exact API request/response schemas
Must_not_implement list is mandatory

ticket_sections.name: future_impact
rules: Lists all tickets that directly depend on this ticket's output
Highlights design constraints imposed by future tickets
Does NOT require implementing future features

ticket_sections.name: technical_specifications
rules: All version numbers from tech_stack.json — no 'latest'
All env var names from infra_design.json
All file paths absolute from project root
Coding conventions embedded directly — never reference external doc
Git instructions must be exact (branch name format, commit format, PR title format)

ticket_sections.name: success_criteria
rules: Every item must be binary (pass/fail)
Test coverage thresholds must be explicit numbers
No subjective items
Must include Given/When/Then scenarios for API endpoints

ticket_sections.name: architecture_compliance
rules: Every reference must be an exact JSON path
Architecture version must be recorded
LLM must verify each item before marking ticket Done
ticket_sections.format: table with columns: Check | Architecture Source | Expected Value | How to Verify

ticket_sections.name: risk_and_rollback
rules: Rollback instructions must be specific enough to execute without thinking
Must distinguish code rollback from database rollback
Must list exact files to delete or revert
Must include shared context rollback if ticket writes to 05_context/

steps.name: PLAN_REVIEW
steps.description: Human must approve plan before any code is written

steps.name: SELF_VERIFY
steps.description: All binary checks in Section 8 must pass

steps.name: CONTEXT_UPDATE
steps.description: Mandatory after PR merge — execute Section 12

ticket_sections.name: context_update_instructions
rules: Must be executed AFTER PR is merged, not before
Every file created must be recorded
Every new endpoint must be recorded in api_state.json
Every new service/class must be recorded in component_state.json
project_context.json progress block must be updated
Instructions must be exact JSON operations, not vague descriptions

columns.name: Backlog
columns.description: Tickets not yet committed to a sprint

columns.name: Plan Review
columns.description: Human reviewing plan. No code written yet.

columns.name: Code Review
columns.description: Human reviewing implementation. PR not yet raised.

absolute_rules.rule: Never generate tickets from an unapproved plan.
Never invent implementation details not in architecture files or task_list.json.
Never generate a ticket without exact architecture references (file + JSON path).
Never merge two tasks into one ticket. One task = one ticket.
Never omit Section 4 (Existing Implementation State). If none: say 'none' explicitly.
Never generate Sprint N tickets before Sprint N-1 tickets are validated.
Forbidden words in acceptance criteria: handle, manage, deal with, appropriate, relevant.
Always embed coding conventions directly in ticket. Never reference external docs.
Always include exact shell verification commands that produce binary pass/fail results.

error_conditions.condition: planning_review_report.md not found or not APPROVED
error_conditions.action: Return ORCHESTRATOR_BLOCKED. Do not generate any tickets.
Halt. Flag task. Request correction from PlanningDesign.
Create empty skeleton and continue. Log creation.

error_conditions.condition: Architecture file referenced in task does not exist
error_conditions.action: Halt. Report missing file and which task references it.

error_conditions.condition: Two tasks in same sprint have dependency between them
error_conditions.action: Flag as planning error. Report to human. Do not generate conflicting ticket.

error_conditions.condition: Acceptance criteria below minimum for risk level
error_conditions.action: Flag ticket. Add placeholder criteria marked REQUIRES_HUMAN_REVIEW.
